notes: Read all 181 source lines line by line before editing. This is a non-visual route-prefetch utility: a hand-maintained PRELOADERS map (route path -> web code-split chunk preloader), a `prefetched` Set, two public functions (prefetchRoute, isPrefetchablePath) and two test helpers. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported; no i18n or unit-conversion in source.

L1-26 module docblock ported and retargeted for native: the web rationale (every App.tsx route code-split via React.lazy, first nav pays chunk-fetch+parse -> PageLoadSkeleton flash, <PrefetchLink> downloads the chunk on hover/focus into the runtime cache so the click renders instantly, each preload at-most-once, failed downloads evicted to retry) is preserved verbatim as the WEB BEHAVIOR reference, then a NATIVE REALITY section (contract rule 7 - browser-only behavior) documents that React Native ships a single Metro bundle with every React Navigation screen already resident, so there are no per-route network chunks to prefetch and the optimization is a tracked no-op. The L16-25 'PRELOADERS mirrors lazy()->import() in App.tsx, HAND-MAINTAINED, add a row per new lazy route, routes not listed are silently skipped' note is preserved, and the L22-25 Vite 'import paths must be string literals for static chunk analysis' constraint is preserved and explicitly marked non-applicable on native (entries are plain path data, no import()).

L28-142 PRELOADERS map: all 113 route-path keys are ported verbatim into `export const PREFETCHABLE_PATHS` (one path per line, exact strings incl. parameterized patterns '/automations/:id/edit', '/charging/:id', '/drives/:id', '/drives/:id/replay', '/s/:token', '/trips/:id', '/vehicles/:id', '/vehicles/:id/access', '/year-review/:year'). Verified by script: web PRELOADERS keys (extracted via /^\s*'([^']+)':\s*\(\)\s*=>\s*import\(/gm) and native PREFETCHABLE_PATHS are an EXACT set match - 113 == 113, zero missing, zero extra, zero dups. The web value side `() => import('../features/.../pages/X')` is intentionally NOT carried across: importing 113 RN page modules eagerly would defeat the purpose and the web module specifier is a browser chunk-identity detail with no native meaning. Instead `buildPreloaders` maps every path to a single shared `nativeNoopPreload` (() => Promise.resolve()), producing a Readonly<Record<string,()=>Promise<unknown>>> with the SAME key set so PRELOADERS[path] lookup, `path in PRELOADERS` membership, and the `.catch` eviction shape are all preserved identically to web.

L144 `const prefetched = new Set<string>()` ported verbatim. L146-166 prefetchRoute(path): logic ported verbatim (empty-path guard, prefetched.has early return, PRELOADERS[path] truthy guard, prefetched.add, `void preload().catch(() => prefetched.delete(path))`); only formatting changed - single-line `if (...) return` expanded to braced returns to satisfy the @react-native eslint `curly` rule (matches globalProgress.ts house style). The docblock's failed-download-eviction contract is preserved with an added note that on native the no-op preload resolves immediately so the eviction branch never fires (kept for contract-shape parity). L168-171 isPrefetchablePath ported verbatim as `path in PRELOADERS`. L173-181 test helpers __resetPrefetchedForTests() (prefetched.clear()) and __getPrefetchedForTests() (return [...prefetched]) ported verbatim.

Additive native-only surface (mirrors existing parity precedents, does not alter web behavior): PREFETCHABLE_PATHS is exported so the parity test can assert lockstep with the web key set, and ROUTE_PREFETCH_NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON documents the browser-only chunk-prefetch seam (same pattern as LOG_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE_REASON / APP_ICON_PNG_UNAVAILABLE_REASON / LEAFLET_GLOBAL_UNAVAILABLE_REASON). Added apps/native/__tests__/routePrefetch.test.ts: mirrors all web routePrefetch.test.ts cases (isPrefetchablePath true/false, prefetchRoute record/idempotent/no-op-unknown/no-op-empty/no-throw) plus a parity guard reading web/src/lib/routePrefetch.ts and asserting PREFETCHABLE_PATHS equals the web PRELOADERS keys, a microtask-flush test proving the native no-op preload never evicts, and a reason-constant assertion.
Gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) all pass; committed apps/native changes only.
